task.ques: Find the year that Tom Brady had the most touchdowns in a single seasson.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: 2007 — Tom Brady threw his single-season career high of 50 passing touchdowns. StatMuse's season table ranks 2007 first, ahead of 2021 with 43.
Source: https://www.statmuse.com/nfl/ask/tom-brady-most-touchdown-passes-in-a-season
Screenshot evidence: final.png.
